verdict.rationale: Asking whether a fraud-protection SaaS platform ships an official CLI is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, mobile SDKs, webhooks and a Try It! panel. None of these is an official command-line tool. SDKs and the API are developer building blocks and earn no credit toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
